record.name: 550 Terry A. Francois Boulevard
record.summary: 550 Terry A. Francois Boulevard is a 6-story office building in Mission Bay, built in 2002 per DataSF Assessor records; it once served as Old Navy's headquarters, was bought by DivcoWest from parent company Gap in 2022, and was reported in September 2024 to have been taken by OpenAI (reports differ on whether as a lease or a sublease, and on its size; see open questions).

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is Assessor lot 8721011 (7,486 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the surveyed building footprint (DataSF Building Footprints (mblr SF8721011)); 99% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 69% of the lot.

The 550 Terry A. Francois notes now say that May 2022 is the date of the REBusinessOnline report that DivcoWest bought the building, not a sale date, and that the report names no seller. The building's earlier owner, Gap, is mentioned only in a Real Deal article that could not be opened, so it is unconfirmed.

The record's summary and map notes called 550 Terry A. Francois Boulevard the longtime Gap Inc./Old Navy corporate headquarters. The Real Deal (2024) and REBusinessOnline (2022) say only that it once served as Old Navy's headquarters and that DivcoWest bought it from parent company Gap in 2022, so the summary now says that and cites both articles. The aerial photo credit now names the Commons account Firstcultural (Alfred Twu, per that account's user page) and drops the 'departing flight' wording, which the file page does not state.

open_questions: Exact month/day of the 2002 completion is not sourced, only the year.

The 2000 permit's own block/lot references (spanning several small blocks in the 3839-3851 range, an older pre-redevelopment block grid) differ from the Assessor's current parcel 8721011; the address (550 Terry A. Francois Blvd), six-story office description, and 2002-09-13 permit-completion date (matching the Assessor's 2002 year exactly) line up with this parcel, so this is treated as Mission Bay's redevelopment-era block renumbering, not a different building.

The building's developer/architect (reported elsewhere as Studios Architecture) was not independently confirmed by any source read as of 2026-09-21 -- left out of this record rather than repeated unsourced.

OpenAI's deal at 550 Terry A. Francois Blvd: The San Francisco Standard (2024-09-20) says OpenAI "just finalized a lease for 350,000 square feet"; Hoodline (2024-09-20) calls it a lease of 315,000 square feet; The Real Deal (2024-09-23) headlines "OpenAI subleases 350K sf building" yet says in its text that OpenAI "plans to occupy a 315,000-square-foot building" and that terms of the deal with owner DivcoWest were not disclosed. Whether this is a lease from the owner or a sublease, and whether the size is 315,000 or 350,000 sq ft, is not settled by these sources; REBusiness (2022-05-25) gives the building as 320,000 sq ft. No lease record was read.
